messages:
Nora: Heads-up: testing found the TS SDK sending both X-Route and route_meta causing console to count usages twice.
Evan: Is this the same as previous routing header issues? any new twist?
Nora: Slight twist: browser fetch() flow encodes slashes in header values (%2F) while node flow sends plain slash. Console treats those as different route keys.
Kai: That explains intermittent spikes in some tenants. We saw batches where half requests show encoded route and half plain.
Evan: Quick fix options: console normalization (decode header values), SDK canonical header (X-Route-Canonical), or client-side change to always encode.
Nora: My vote: console normalizer hotfix because it covers Hosted immediately. Then SDK minor patch to emit X-Route-Canonical.
Kai: For Dedicated, proxies might already normalize; ops needs to verify. I'll open OPS ticket.
ops-bot: ops: opened ticket OPS-827 for proxy normalization.
Evan: Add telemetry event route_alias_detected so we can quantify impact before merging buckets.
Nora: I'll prepare a small repro script and a console PR for normalization behind a feature flag. Canaries tomorrow.
Evan: Thanks. Keep product in the loop for any billing reconciliations.
